hint.label: Vocabulary list

atoms.b: It is important to ((distinguish)) between generational patterns and the ((individual_traits)), that define each person within a generation.
Many people hold ((stereotypical)) assumptions about younger and older generations, believing that all members of an age group share identical values and behaviours.
Instead of starting a ((blame_game)) where Boomers accuse Gen Z of being lazy and Gen Z calls Boomers selfish, we should talk openly about how each generation experienced different challenges.
Just as some seniors maintain a ((conservative_worldview)) while others embrace progressive ideas, there are countless younger people who also embrace traditional values and ((gender_roles)).
Each of us has a ((responsibility)) to look at people as individuals and not judge them only by the generation they belong to.
